description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimEventAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing claim events within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim events, with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: ClaimEventAPI
classes.description: API class for managing claim events, including create, read, update, delete operations with validation and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ClaimEvent object, sets its name, description, status, and saves it via the DAO.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Sets description and status for a ClaimEvent, assigns user, and saves via DAO.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim events based on search filters, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a claim event.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' property, including uniqueness check.

methods.name: getClaimEventCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Provides common options for unique property validation, ignoring deleted records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes claim events by IDs after verifying their existence.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single claim event by ID, including whether it can be edited.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim event, with checks on whether the name can be edited.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a claim event.
